title: Affine sum contraction
statement:

u$ be probability measures on $\mathbb R$, let $p,q\in[0,\infty]$ satisfy $1\le p\le q$, and let $ho\in\mathbb R$. Suppose that for each $	heta\in\{\mu,
u\}$ and all $a,b\in\mathbb R$, the extended $L^p$ and $L^q$ seminorms satisfy $\|x\mapsto a+ho bx\|_{L^q(	heta)}\le\|x\mapsto a+bx\|_{L^p(	heta)}$. Then for all $a,b\in\mathbb R$, $\| (x,y)\mapsto a+ho b(x+y)\|_{L^q(\mu	imes
